subject: Discovery recap + rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: James Lee <james.lee@hightowerai.com>, Sana Khan <sana.khan@hightowerai.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + rotating demo slots

Hi James / Sana —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really appreciated the candid discussion about Hightower's inference requirements and where reliability + predictable cost matter most for your recommendations engine. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

Recap:
- You run nightly batch embedding pipelines and a low-latency reranking service for search (p50 latencies need to stay < 100ms).
- Primary concerns: data residency for EU customers, multi-region failover, and cost predictability for peak LIST queries.
- Tech stakeholders to join next: Sana (data residency lead) and one of your infra engineers.

Proposed next step:
- 60-minute technical deep dive / demo focused on: routing & fallbacks, quantization trade-offs, and a short run-through of our deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Because your team is distributed, I wanted to propose a rotating meeting cadence so the burden of early/late meetings rotates across time zones. Below are three sample slots we can rotate weekly — tell me which works best for your core team, and we’ll lock the first two dates. 

Proposed rotating slots (local times + UTC):
- Slot A (US morning): Tue 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT / 15:00 UTC
- Slot B (EU afternoon): Wed 4:00 PM CEST / 7:00 AM PT / 14:00 UTC
- Slot C (APAC friendly): Thu 9:00 AM SGT / Wed 9:00 PM PT / 01:00 UTC (next day)

If helpful, we can do: Week 1 = Slot A, Week 2 = Slot B, Week 3 = Slot C, repeat. That gives everyone at least one meeting during normal hours every three weeks.

Options to pick a single meeting to lock:
- I can send calendar invites for the first two occurrences once you confirm preferred slot(s).
- Or you can pick a time directly on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/demo-60min

I've attached a one-pager with the demo outline and a proposed mutual action plan (see attached file). Aditya (cc) will lead the deep dive and Camila will handle the follow-up and onboarding questions.

Attachments: redwood-demo-one-pager.pdf

Thanks — look forward to syncing.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
From: James Lee <james.lee@hightowerai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.inference>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.inference>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2026 09:34:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + rotating demo slots

Thanks Marissa — great recap and appreciate the thoughtful rotation idea.

A couple quick notes from our side: 
- We prefer Tue/Thu mornings ET for product demos (that tends to be when our PM + eng leads are available).
- For technical deep dives, our infra lead Sana (cc) will need to join — she’s focused on residency and networking constraints.
- A 60-minute slot is perfect. For the rotation, something like Week 1 = Tue 11:00 AM ET (Slot A) / Week 2 = Wed 4:00 PM CEST (Slot B) works for us.

If you can send two invites (first occurrences) for those slots I’ll confirm internally and we’ll lock them.

Appreciate it — James

Thanks James — perfect, glad that cadence looks reasonable. Per your ask, I’ve drafted the first two occurrences and a suggested rotation plan below. I also added a shared sheet so we can log preferred attendees per meeting (link below).

Suggested first occurrences (I'll send invites once you confirm):
- Occurrence 1 (Slot A): Tue, Sep 22, 2026 — 11:00 AM ET / 8:00 AM PT / 15:00 UTC — 60 minutes
- Occurrence 2 (Slot B): Wed, Sep 30, 2026 — 4:00 PM CEST / 7:00 AM PT / 14:00 UTC — 60 minutes

Rotation plan (weekly repeats across three-week cycle):
- Week 1: Slot A (US morning)
- Week 2: Slot B (EU afternoon)
- Week 3: Slot C (APAC friendly)

Action items:
- James / Sana: confirm the two occurrences above or propose alternates.
- James: confirm any additional infra engineers to invite.
- Aditya (cc): we’ll need an architecture diagram and the short runbook for residency controls in the demo. Can you prep and attach the diagram?

Shared scheduling links:
- Calendly (pick alternate times if those clashes): https://calendly.com/redwood-marissa/demo-60min
- Shared sheet for attendees/notes: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-sheet

Marissa
